title: At 5 she testified against a thief. At 85 she won the Nobel Peace Prize.

research.source: Wikipedia 'In the news' (Main Page, 10 Oct 2026) + en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navi_Pillay, scraped with Lightpanda
facts: Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay, born 23 Sept 1941, poor neighbourhood of Durban; grandparents came from India as indentured sugar-plantation workers in the 1890s
Aged 5 she testified in court after being robbed of 5 pounds (her father's monthly wages); thief convicted, money never returned
1967: started her own law firm (first woman to do so in Natal); defended anti-apartheid activists
1995: first non-white female judge of the High Court of South Africa; then judge and president of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda
UN High Commissioner for Human Rights 2008-2014; Nobel Peace Prize 2026
research.timeliness: Nobel Peace Prize announced this week; peak search window is the next 7-10 days

style_block: Mixed-media hand-cut PAPER COLLAGE, editorial zine style, theme 'newsprint-editorial' mixed with South African protest-poster screenprint. Torn and scissor-cut paper edges, masking-tape corners, heavy halftone print dots, newspaper clippings, rubber-stamp marks, real paper drop shadows. Figures are PRINTED-texture halftone cut-outs, not CGI, not a 3D render, keep print grain. Palette: cream, deep red, gold, charcoal. Vertical 9:16 poster, flat scanned lighting. Keep the bottom quarter simple.

beats.script: At *five,* she stood in a courtroom || and testified against the man || who *robbed* her.
He stole *five* *pounds.* || Her father's wages for the month. || The thief was convicted. || The money... || never came *back.*
Her grandparents were *indentured* || sugar-cane workers. || Under apartheid, || she wasn't supposed to win || anything.
She opened her own law firm. || Then became South Africa's || first *non-white* woman || High Court judge.
She judged genocide || at the Rwanda tribunal. || Then led *<U.N.|U N>* human rights.
This month, at <85,|eighty-five,> || Navi Pillay won || the *Nobel* *Peace* *Prize.* || That courtroom || finally paid her *back.*
